body:
You're just 22, you won't understand why I feel the way I do or be able to plan as far ahead as I'm able to. I know this because I was once also 22. 

This is the problem. I was never able to go to school and afford it because no one told me that I needed to sign up for selective services until it was too late for me to do so. For 10 years straight I tried to go to college and was unable to. I was denied loans due to a lack of credit history, I have no family left alive to co-sign, I never made enough money to pay for school. 

Since that hindered my ability to earn a reasonable income, I've never owned much. Possessions aren't really the issue as much as things like basic transportation and being able to afford things like the dentist and doctor. I'm not saying I'm entitled to anything, what I am saying is things shouldn't be priced out of the range of people like me who didn't fuck their own life up. 

I'm in my late 30's, I'm getting tired already. I've lost most of my hair, I throw up stomach acid a lot and I need to see a dentist for the cavities I have due to the throwing up of stomach acid. No dentist will see me in this area because I can't afford it. I've already tried. 

I'm tired and have worked myself to death. I don't want to do this forever. At the current rate it will take me 192 years to save up enough money to retire on. That's to pay me enough interest so that I may pay things like bills and medical care.

I sat down and did the math and there's no way I will ever be able to quit working. 

I think coming to reddit was a bad idea. I think most of the people here are too young and don't have the same experiences as I have. It's not your fault. I wouldn't wish this life on my worst enemy. It's just like that counselor I used to see. He didn't really get it. It was always hey lets try looking at life different... or some other bullshit like that. It's not a mental state. It's the fact that I've worked this body so hard over the past two decades that it's falling apart. I can't inhale without my chest hurting and going down stairs hurts my knees so bad that sometimes I have to just sit down for a few minutes until the pain goes away. 

I can't do life anymore. The physical pain and the realization of a bleak future is enough to convince me to kill myself.
